name: multi-write-close
description: Closing turn where the athlete's message implies three things at once - a session update (session_reconcile), a quest completion (quest_event), and enough conversation for a coach_note. Stresses ADR 0012's one atomic commit per turn: all three should land in this single reply, not just the first one Gemini notices. The eval only checks the returned reply shape, not the actual write, so this only catches Gemini dropping a field - it can't verify the write itself is atomic.
